title: Glowing teddy bear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe9a8' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='26' r='12' fill='#c98a52'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='26' r='6' fill='#f2c48d'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='26' r='12' fill='#c98a52'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='26' r='6' fill='#f2c48d'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='22' fill='#e0a262'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#f7d7a8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#8a5a2e'/>
  <rect x='49' y='47' width='2' height='5' fill='#8a5a2e' rx='1'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#fff6dc'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#fff6dc'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 50 Q50 55 56 50' fill='none' stroke='#8a5a2e' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='22' ry='19' fill='#e0a262'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='79' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#f7d7a8'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='70' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#d09556' transform='rotate(20 26 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='70' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#d09556' transform='rotate(-20 74 70)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='95' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#d09556'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='95' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#d09556'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='95' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f7d7a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='95' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f7d7a8'/>
</svg>
